craft_notes: Sthāyin: beast defined — the ahnika's sting. Rows: business, birth, naming. Rejected: softening beast — killed: beast is the verdict. Read aloud: naming blow.

lines: In cause and act, and even in hers the play is done;
hence from kalā the fourfold is born:
even this knowledge, so far-seeing, the scholar
I make — thus wise, that awareness
in the body, in fort, in eight-ness even —
l4.sanskrit_cite: kāryakāraṇabhāve 'pi asyā eva vyāpāraḥ tena kalāta eva etac catuṣkaṃ jātam idam eva kiṃcid adhunā jānan abhiṣvaktaḥ karomi ity evaṃrūpā saṃvid dehapuryaṣṭakādigatā paśur ity ucyate
